Ultra Rare.name: Ancient Lamp
Ultra Rare.desc: During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon "La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp" from your hand. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect. Before damage calculation, if this card is being attacked by an opponent's monster, and was face-down at the start of the Damage Step: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls, except the attacking monster; the attacking monster attacks it instead, and you proceed to damage calculation.

Ultra Rare.name: Battle Ox
Ultra Rare.desc: A monster with tremendous power, it destroys enemies with a swing of its axe.

Ultra Rare.name: Blade Knight
Ultra Rare.desc: Gains 400 ATK while you have 1 or less cards in your hand. If you control no other monsters, the effects of Flip monsters destroyed by battle with this card are negated.

Ultra Rare.name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon
Ultra Rare.desc: "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"

Ultra Rare.name: Card of Demise
Ultra Rare.desc: Draw until you have 3 cards in your hand, also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, your opponent takes no damage. During the End Phase of this turn, send your entire hand to the GY. You can only activate 1 "Card of Demise" per turn. You cannot Special Summon during the turn you activate this card.

Ultra Rare.name: Cloning
Ultra Rare.desc: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons a monster that has a Level: Target that face-up monster; Special Summon 1 "Clone Token", with the same original Type, Attribute, Level, ATK, and DEF as that target. When that target is destroyed and sent to the GY, destroy this Token.

Ultra Rare.name: Cost Down
Ultra Rare.desc: Discard 1 card; for the rest of this turn, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).

Ultra Rare.name: Crush Card Virus
Ultra Rare.desc: Tribute 1 DARK monster with 1000 or less ATK; your opponent takes no damage until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, also, you look at your opponent's hand and all monsters they control, and if you do, destroy the monsters among them with 1500 or more ATK, then your opponent can destroy up to 3 monsters with 1500 or more ATK in their Deck.

Ultra Rare.name: Dark Energy
Ultra Rare.desc: Increase the ATK and DEF of a Fiend-Type monster equipped with this card by 300 points.

Ultra Rare.name: Des Feral Imp
Ultra Rare.desc: FLIP: Target 1 card in your Graveyard; shuffle that target into the Deck.

Ultra Rare.name: Enemy Controller
Ultra Rare.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.
● Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

Ultra Rare.name: Fiend's Sanctuary
Ultra Rare.desc: Special Summon 1 "Metal Fiend Token" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). It cannot attack. Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving it. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 1000 LP or destroy this Token.

Ultra Rare.name: Final Attack Orders
Ultra Rare.desc: All face-up monsters on the field are changed to Attack Position and their battle positions cannot be changed.

Ultra Rare.name: Gadget Soldier
Ultra Rare.desc: A rust-free machine warrior born to battle.

Ultra Rare.name: Gift of The Mystical Elf
Ultra Rare.desc: Increase your Life Points by 300 points for each monster on the field.

Ultra Rare.name: Gyakutenno Megami
Ultra Rare.desc: This fairy uses her mystical power to protect the weak and provide spiritual support.

Ultra Rare.name: Hitotsu-Me Giant
Ultra Rare.desc: A one-eyed behemoth with thick, powerful arms made for delivering punishing blows.

Ultra Rare.name: Hyozanryu
Ultra Rare.desc: A dragon created from a massive diamond that sparkles with blinding light.

Ultra Rare.name: Interdimensional Matter Transporter
Ultra Rare.desc: Target 1 face-up monster you control; banish that target until the End Phase.

Ultra Rare.name: Invitation to a Dark Sleep
Ultra Rare.desc: When this monster is summoned (excluding Special Summon), select 1 of your opponent's monsters. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, the selected monster cannot attack.

Ultra Rare.name: Judge Man
Ultra Rare.desc: This club-wielding warrior battles to the end and will never surrender.

Ultra Rare.name: Kaiser Glider
Ultra Rare.desc: Cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has the same ATK. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.

Ultra Rare.name: La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp
Ultra Rare.desc: A genie of the lamp that is at the beck and call of its master.

Ultra Rare.name: Lord of D.
Ultra Rare.desc: Neither player can target Dragon monsters on the field with card effects.

Ultra Rare.name: Lullaby of Obedience
Ultra Rare.desc:
Pay 2000 LP and declare 1 Monster Card name; your opponent looks at their Deck, reveals 1 of the declared monsters if there is any, and chooses 1 of these effects to be applied.
● The declared monster is added to the hand of the player who activated this card.
● The player who activated this card Special Summons the declared monster to their field in Attack Position, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

Ultra Rare.name: Masked Beast Des Gardius
Ultra Rare.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 2 monsters, including at least 1 "Grand Tiki Elder" or "Melchid the Four-Face Beast". When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, equip 1 "The Mask of Remnants" from your Deck to 1 monster on the field.

Ultra Rare.name: Megamorph
Ultra Rare.desc: While your LP is lower than your opponent's, the equipped monster's ATK becomes double its original ATK. While your LP is higher, the equipped monster's ATK becomes half its original ATK.

Ultra Rare.name: Mesmeric Control
Ultra Rare.desc: During your opponent's next turn after you activate this card, your opponent cannot change the battle positions of monsters, except with a card effect.

Ultra Rare.name: Monster Reborn
Ultra Rare.desc: Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it.

Ultra Rare.name: Mystic Horseman
Ultra Rare.desc: Half man and half horse, this monster is known for its extreme speed.

Ultra Rare.name: Negate Attack
Ultra Rare.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, then end the Battle Phase.

Ultra Rare.name: Obelisk the Tormentor
Ultra Rare.desc: Requires 3 Tributes to Normal Summon (cannot be Normal Set). This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. When Normal Summoned, cards and effects cannot be activated. Neither player can target this card with card effects. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned: Send it to the GY. You can Tribute 2 monsters; destroy all monsters your opponent controls. This card cannot declare an attack the turn this effect is activated.

Ultra Rare.name: Polymerization
Ultra Rare.desc: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material.

Ultra Rare.name: Rabid Horseman
Ultra Rare.desc: "Battle Ox" + "Mystic Horseman"

Ultra Rare.name: Ring of Destruction
Ultra Rare.desc: During your opponent's turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls whose ATK is less than or equal to their LP; destroy that face-up monster, and if you do, take damage equal to its original ATK, then inflict damage to your opponent, equal to the damage you took. You can only activate 1 "Ring of Destruction" per turn.

Ultra Rare.name: Rude Kaiser
Ultra Rare.desc: With an axe in each hand, this monster delivers heavy damage.

Ultra Rare.name: Ryu-Kishin
Ultra Rare.desc: A very elusive creature that looks like a harmless statue until it attacks.

Ultra Rare.name: Ryu-Kishin Powered
Ultra Rare.desc: A gargoyle enhanced by the powers of darkness. Very sharp talons make it a worthy opponent.

Ultra Rare.name: Saggi the Dark Clown
Ultra Rare.desc: This clown appears from nowhere and executes very strange moves to avoid enemy attacks.

Ultra Rare.name: Shadow Spell
Ultra Rare.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses 700 ATK, also it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card.

Ultra Rare.name: Shrink
Ultra Rare.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; its original ATK becomes halved until the end of this turn.

Ultra Rare.name: Silent Doom
Ultra Rare.desc: Target 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position, but it cannot attack.

Ultra Rare.name: Soul Exchange
Ultra Rare.desc: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; this turn, if you Tribute a monster, you must Tribute that target, as if you controlled it. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

Ultra Rare.name: Spell Absorption
Ultra Rare.desc: Each time a Spell Card is activated, gain 500 LP immediately after it resolves.

Ultra Rare.name: Steel Ogre Grotto #2
Ultra Rare.desc: A mechanized iron doll with tremendous strength.

Ultra Rare.name: Stop Defense
Ultra Rare.desc: Select 1 Defense Position monster on your opponent's side of the field and change it to Attack Position.

Ultra Rare.name: Swordstalker
Ultra Rare.desc: A monster formed by the vengeful souls of those who passed away in battle.

Ultra Rare.name: The Flute of Summoning Dragon
Ultra Rare.desc: Special Summon up to 2 Dragon monsters from your hand. "Lord of D." must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

Ultra Rare.name: The Wicked Worm Beast
Ultra Rare.desc: This face-up card on the field is returned to the owner's hand during the End Phase of your turn.

Ultra Rare.name: Virus Cannon
Ultra Rare.desc: Tribute any number of monsters, except Tokens; your opponent sends an equal number of Spells from their Deck to the GY (or all their Spells, if lower than the number of Tributes).

Ultra Rare.name: Vorse Raider
Ultra Rare.desc: This wicked Beast-Warrior does every horrid thing imaginable, and loves it! His axe bears the marks of his countless victims.

Ultra Rare.name: X-Head Cannon
Ultra Rare.desc: A monster with a mighty cannon barrel, it is able to integrate its attacks. It attacks in many ways by combining and separating with other monsters.

Ultra Rare.name: XY-Dragon Cannon
Ultra Rare.desc:
"X-Head Cannon" + "Y-Dragon Head"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

Ultra Rare.name: XYZ-Dragon Cannon
Ultra Rare.desc:
"X-Head Cannon" + "Y-Dragon Head" + "Z-Metal Tank"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

Ultra Rare.name: Y-Dragon Head
Ultra Rare.desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "X-Head Cannon" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 400 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

Ultra Rare.name: Z-Metal Tank
Ultra Rare.desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "X-Head Cannon" or "Y-Dragon Head" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 600 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

New.name: Attack Guidance Armor
New.desc:
When a monster declares an attack: Activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy the attacking monster.
● Target 1 monster on either field, except the attacking monster; change the attack target to it and perform damage calculation.
You can only activate 1 "Attack Guidance Armor" per turn.

New.name: Grappler
New.desc: A devious snake with a thick body that wraps around an enemy monster and squeezes the life out of it.

New.name: Life Shaver
New.desc: You can only control 1 "Life Shaver". Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Place 1 counter on this card. During the Main or Battle Phase, if this card has a counter(s) on it: You can send this card to the GY, then make your opponent discard as many cards as possible, up to the number of counters that were on this card.

New.name: Magical Trick Mirror
New.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target 1 Spell in your opponent's GY; Set it to your field. You can banish this card from your GY and send 1 "Monster Reborn" from your hand or face-down field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Obelisk the Tormentor" from your GY in Defense Position, and if you activated this effect during your opponent's turn, all monsters your opponent controls that can attack must attack that face-up monster, this turn, while you control it.

Quarter Century Secret Rare.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
Quarter Century Secret Rare.desc: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.
